definitions.gloss: transfer expenses; costs of selling an asset
definitions.explanation: The costs incurred in transferring ownership of property or another asset — brokerage commissions, stamp duty, demolition or surveying fees. In Japanese tax practice these are subtracted, along with the acquisition cost, when calculating taxable capital gains.

examples.japanese: {譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}{手数料|てすうりょう}→仲介手数料：10290_chuukaitesuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれます→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The brokerage commission is included in the transfer expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{譲渡|じょうと}→譲渡：15629_jouto⟧⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}{費|ひ}→取得費：30244_shutokuhi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いて→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧⟦{求|もと}めます→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Capital gains are found by subtracting the acquisition cost and the transfer expenses from the sale price.

notes:
A tax and real-estate term, made of ⟦{譲渡|じょうと}→譲渡：15629_jouto⟧ (transfer, conveyance) and ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (expense). Only costs directly required to complete the sale count; ordinary repairs and property tax do not.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to qualify as a transfer expense
- {譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to be recognized as a transfer expense
- {譲渡費用|じょうとひよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く→差し引く：06701_sashihiku⟧: to deduct the transfer expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取得|しゅとく}{費|ひ}→取得費：30244_shutokuhi⟧: acquisition cost — what the seller originally paid for the asset, deducted separately
- ⟦{諸経費|しょけいひ}→諸経費：15155_shokeihi⟧: miscellaneous expenses — a general business term with no specific tax meaning
